name: asset-lifecycle
description: Creates a new asset, saves it, and transitions through workflow states: Draft → Active → Inactive

doc_metadata.title: Asset List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Asset list page by clicking 'Asset' in the sidebar or visiting /asset. This page shows all registered assets in a data table with search, filter, and sort capabilities.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Opening screenshot for the Asset Management chapter.

doc_metadata.title: Create New Asset
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' in the top-right corner to open the asset creation form. You will be redirected to a blank form where you can enter the asset details.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the Add New button before clicking.

doc_metadata.title: Fill Form Field
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "Test Pump Assembly E2E" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: Asset Form Filled
doc_metadata.caption: Fill in the asset details. The 'Description' field is the primary identifier. Additional fields can be filled as needed.

doc_metadata.title: Save New Asset
doc_metadata.caption: After filling in the required fields, click 'Save' to create the asset record. A success notification appears confirming the asset was created.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the save button and the success toast.

doc_metadata.title: Asset Details View
doc_metadata.caption: After saving, you are taken to the asset detail page where you can view all fields, switch tabs, and manage workflow state.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Full page showing the saved asset with workflow state badge.
